name: Crushes
overview: Scripture cautions believers to place their ultimate desire and affection in God alone, as expressed in Psalms 73:25, rather than being captivated by fleeting physical beauty or lust, which Proverbs 6:25 warns against. The wisdom literature further teaches that impulsive or secretive actions driven by misguided desires lead to sorrow and sin (Proverbs 10:10; 19:2), while open and honest correction is preferable to hidden affection (Proverbs 27:5). True worth and praise come not from outward charm but from a reverent fear of the Lord, as highlighted in Proverbs 31:30.
